name: UTILITY_TYPE
desc: The service actually billed: electricity (power, billed kWh) or water (cubic metres)
reject: The issuer name alone; an unchecked service option; an unrelated zero water line

name: ACCOUNT_NO
desc: Utility account number: Account No, Acct No, Account ID, Customer Account Number (CAN) in the utility account section
reject: Bank or remittance account; Service ID / SIN; membership ID; premises unit number; invoice number

name: INVOICE_NO
desc: Invoice number: Invoice No, Billing Invoice No, Bill No, the invoice's own serial number
reject: Bill reference or statement number without invoice authority; revision suffix; Code No; issue date

name: START_DATE
desc: Start of the billed service period: Period From, FROM cell of the service or reading period
reject: Invoice or issue date; a presumed cycle start; another meter's period

name: END_DATE
desc: End of the billed service period: Period To, TO cell; the present-reading date when no explicit period end exists
reject: A numeric present reading; disconnection date; a conflicting period

name: COVERAGE
desc: Month of START_DATE; day 16 or later counts as the next month

name: DUE_DATE
desc: Payment due date: Due Date, Payment Due Date, Pay on or before
reject: Disconnection date; invoice date; posting date

name: PREV_READING
desc: Previous meter reading: Previous Reading, Prev Rdg, PREVIOUS in the meter-reading table
reject: Previous balance; previous consumption; the date of the previous reading

name: CURRENT_READING
desc: Present meter reading: Present Reading, Current Reading, Pres Rdg, PRESENT in the meter-reading table
reject: Current charges; the date of the present reading; a different meter's reading

name: MULTIPLIER
desc: Meter multiplier: Multiplier, multiplying factor, explicit meter factor
reject: A percentage; a monetary multiplication factor; never assume a default when none is printed

name: CORELOSS
desc: Explicit core-loss quantity with its units (for example kWh)
reject: Core-loss charge in money; a difference inferred from readings

name: USAGE
desc: Billed or actual energy consumption for this bill in kWh: kWh Used, Actual Consumption, Billed kWh
reject: Demand in kW; a meter reading; export credit; another period's usage; a quantity on an unrelated charge line

name: DEMAND
desc: Printed billed demand quantity in kW, including an explicit zero
reject: Demand charge in money; kWh usage; a minimum demand unless the bill says it is the billed demand

name: RATE
desc: Overall printed consumption tariff per kWh for the whole bill (for example 'Your rate this month')
reject: Generation or transmission component tariff; VAT percentage; export rate; a conflicting tariff

name: UTILITY
desc: GRAND_TOTAL minus VAT_COST

name: PENALTY
desc: Penalty or surcharge actually charged on this bill, including an explicit zero amount
reject: A future late-payment rate; an amount payable only after the due date

name: VAT_COST
desc: Total VAT amount of the current bill: printed total VAT, or the VAT Amount in the tax summary
reject: VAT rate; VATable sales base; TIN; a government-tax subtotal; one VAT component of several

name: EWT_COST
desc: Expanded withholding tax amount in money actually applied on this bill (EWT, WTAX, Expanded Withholding)
reject: A rate alone; a Form 2307 number; a conditional deduction that was not applied

name: GRAND_TOTAL
desc: Gross amount of the current bill only: Current Charges, Total Current Billing, Current Bill, Charges for this billing period
reject: A total that includes arrears or a previous balance; a net amount after withholding; an after-due-date total

name: NET_AMT
desc: GRAND_TOTAL minus EWT_COST
